user_query: I'm starting a new business venture and I need some inspiration for my speech. Could you provide me with motivational quotes and words of wisdom to include in my announcement? Additionally, I would like to gather news articles and success stories about entrepreneurs for further inspiration.

TaskList.description: Gather motivational quotes and words of wisdom relevant to business and entrepreneurship.
Search for recent news articles about entrepreneurs to collect success stories and insights.
Compile gathered quotes and articles into a cohesive format for easy reference.
